title: Refusal / gap list
description: The claim-bound refusal shape published as decision_memo.pdf's gap_list field. A non-empty gap list is never by itself sufficient: every entry is graded against its own claim_id, paired against evidence_manifest.csv's claim_id for that same claim, so that refusing a claim earns credit only where the claim was genuinely unsupported, and refusing an answerable claim loses the credit that claim would otherwise have earned. Never a free-text blob - every entry names one specific claim and one specific withheld field.

claim_id.description: The identifier of the specific claim being refused. Binds to evidence_manifest.csv's claim_id column for the same claim - the same pattern is used in both places so a claim can be traced whether it was answered or refused.

gap_type.description: The category of the evidentiary gap.

blocked_field.description: The single published output field name (from case/scripts/field_vocabulary.py's ALL_PUBLISHED_NAMES) being withheld because of this gap. Must be a member of the published vocabulary - never a free-text description of what is missing. This is what lets a paired refusal check and a paired no-false-refusal check each bind to one specific claim and one specific field.

evidence_checked.description: What source WAS examined before concluding a definitive answer could not be given. A gap must show diligence, not merely absence.

what_would_resolve.description: A one-line statement of what additional source or authorization would resolve this specific gap.

definitive_conclusion_withheld.description: True if a definitive conclusion on this specific claim is being withheld in favor of this gap entry.
